description: Convert between ISO 8601 durations, seconds, clock time and human text like "1h30m" or "90 minutes". Operations: "convert" — Parse any duration (ISO 8601, 1h30m, 90 minutes, 1:30:00, seconds) into every representation.; "to-iso" — Convert any duration to a canonical ISO 8601 duration string.; "humanize" — Render a duration as words ("1 hour 30 minutes") or compact text ("1h 30m").. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant).

input.description: convert: A duration in any supported format. to-iso: A duration in any supported format. humanize: A duration in any supported format.

operation.description: convert — Parse any duration (ISO 8601, 1h30m, 90 minutes, 1:30:00, seconds) into every representation. to-iso — Convert any duration to a canonical ISO 8601 duration string. humanize — Render a duration as words ("1 hour 30 minutes") or compact text ("1h 30m").

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

calendarUnits.description: Use years (365 d) and months (30 d). Used by: to-iso.

compact.description: Use 1h 30m instead of words. Used by: humanize.

weeks.description: Use PnW when the value is whole weeks. Used by: to-iso.

name: duration
title: Duration Converter
